body: Orchestrator review of PR #362 (dotfiles-T128-project-map-reload-hook-followup-a01, head 95e7fb3f on base 04590ae9), read from the fetched head: the hook changes exactly where the three owned rows point: the targetId filter becomes strict 32-hex (`test("^[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}\z")`, audit:2fb97db:1 target-id-validation), both agent-browser calls pin the bound tab (`--pin-tab`, local:2fb97db:1 pin-both-calls), and the reload runs only when the tab's pathname still ends in /.project-map/index.html (`if (location.pathname.endsWith(...)) location.reload()`, worker:30cbfb4:1 the tab-fallback guard); the shdoc description gains one sentence. Three new tests named for the rows (`test_project_map_reload_hook_guards_against_a_tab_navigating_away`, `test_project_map_reload_hook_pins_the_bound_tab_when_it_closes`, `test_project_map_reload_hook_accepts_only_cdp_target_ids`), 80 local tests pass. Caps: 4 added and 3 deleted lines outside tests and .orchestration (7 of 200), 147 added under tests (of 1000). The Bot left no review object and no comment within the 15-minute window; its summary comment (6181868447) says the code and security reviews completed on this head: bot none, no threads, no P0/P1. CI 13 of 13. The task copy on the branch equals the dispatched b8b18a8f. The worker's disclosure: a fresh attach without a binding creates a blank tab before the map selection (pin-sticky), named for the audit. Main will move when #360 merges, so the chain update-branches first. No finding.
